fixed_skill.desc:
Increase party's Attack by 14.0%/14.7%/15.4%, and grant Agonizing Stigmata for 2 turns.
Agonizing Stigmata: Based on current HP, gain one of the following effects.
Under 80%: Increase damage by 8.0%/8.4%/8.8%.
Under 60%: Increase damage by 12.0%/12.6%/13.2%.
Under 40%: Increase damage by 12.0%/12.6%/13.2%, and increase critical damage by 20.0%/21.0%/22.0%.
fixed_skill.name: Guidance of Souls
